parsed.name: 超导持久磁体线圈
parsed.description: 这是一种带持久开关与加热器的超导磁体线圈，用于低温与量子器件实验中产生稳定磁场。实验时通常先由外部电流源给线圈充电，再切换到持久模式以在断开电源后维持磁场，并可进行失超检查、电流与磁场换算以及磁场缓慢扫场控制。
parsed.description_en: This is a superconducting magnet coil with a persistent switch and heater, used in cryogenic and quantum-device experiments to generate stable magnetic fields. The coil is typically energized by an external current source and then switched into persistent mode so the field can be maintained after disconnecting the source. It supports quench checking, current-field conversion, and controlled field ramping.

actions.description_en: Compensate field drift while the coil is in persistent mode, or ramp the source current to zero for source disconnection.

actions.description_en: Bring the external source current into agreement with the present persistent field for subsequent switch operation or further field control.
